embedding.description: Optional embedding group. When omitted the agent runs without feed retrieval (RAG) and feed indexing is skipped.

fallback.description: Optional retry-model group. Supply all three fields or omit the section entirely.

llm.description: Optional main-LLM group. Required for the AI Agent; without it feeds and other features keep working.

tavily.description: Optional search provider group. When omitted the agent does not plan web searches.

status.description: Overall status: 'ok' when the database is reachable, 'error' otherwise.
Always 'ok' as long as the process is serving HTTP.

api_key.description: Write-only API key. Required on create; leave empty on update to keep the stored key.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL including the provider's version prefix (for example, a trailing /v1). Private and localhost addresses are allowed.

model.description: Model name as the configured endpoint expects it.

api_key_masked.description: Masked preview of the stored key: the last four characters only. The plaintext key is write-only and never returned.

api_key.description: Write-only API key. Optional: an empty key uses the provider's keyless tier; on update, empty keeps the stored key.

base_url.description: Search provider base URL. Omit the whole section to run without web search.

api_key_masked.description: Masked preview of the stored key: the last four characters only. The plaintext key is write-only and never returned.

embedding.description: Optional embedding group to probe. Blank api_key resolves to the stored key exactly as PUT does.

llm.description: Optional main-LLM group to probe. Blank api_key resolves to the stored key exactly as PUT does.

slots.description: Optional subset of slots to probe: chat, embedding, fallback, tavily. Absent probes every filled slot.

tavily.description: Optional search-provider group to probe. Blank api_key probes the provider's keyless tier when no key is stored.

BearerAuth.description: JWT bearer token issued by POST /api/login or POST /api/register.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of feeds owned by the authenticated caller, optionally filtered by a search term matched against title and description.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive search term matched against title and description.
parameters.name: q

schema.description: Case-insensitive search term matched against title and description.

parameters.description: Items per page; clamped to a server-side maximum of 100.
parameters.name: page_size

schema.description: Items per page; clamped to a server-side maximum of 100.

parameters.description: Sort direction: 'desc' returns newest first (default), 'asc' returns oldest first.
parameters.name: order

schema.description: Sort direction: 'desc' returns newest first (default), 'asc' returns oldest first.

post.description: Creates a new feed record. Requires a valid JWT in the Authorization header.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a feed record. Requires a valid JWT.

get.description: Returns a single feed owned by the authenticated caller. Returns 404 if the feed does not exist OR is owned by another user — single sentinel, no existence leak.

put.description: Updates the title or description of an existing feed. Requires a valid JWT.

get.description: Deep readiness check — reports the status of the API, the database connection, and the cache (active implementation and probe result).

post.summary: Index the caller's visible knowledge sources

get.summary: Get knowledge base settings for the caller

patch.summary: Enable or disable a knowledge source

get.description: Shallow liveness check — returns 200 as long as the process is up. Does NOT probe the database or cache; use /api/health for a deep readiness signal.

post.description: Authenticate a user by username + password. The response body carries the access token, refresh token, token type, expiry, and user profile.
Revoke the refresh token identified in the request body and every rotated token in its family. Requires a valid access token in the Authorization header. Returns 204.

Revoke every active refresh token for the authenticated user. Access tokens already issued remain valid until they expire (at most the configured access TTL, default 15m). Requires a valid access token in the Authorization header. Returns 204.

get.description: Return the profile of the authenticated user (the access token's subject). Used by the SPA to reconcile its persisted user on every page load.

delete.description: Removes the authenticated caller's LLM configuration. Idempotent: deleting an unconfigured user also returns 204.

get.description: Returns the authenticated caller's per-user LLM configuration with API keys masked to their last four characters. A user with no saved configuration receives configured=false with null sections.

put.description: Validates and upserts the authenticated caller's optional main LLM, optional embedding, optional Tavily, and optional retry-model configuration. API keys are write-only: a blank key on update keeps the stored key; on create a key is required unless the endpoint is loopback. Omitting Tavily disables web search for the agent. Responds with the masked configuration.

post.description: Runs one minimal live request per filled slot (main LLM, embedding, fallback, Tavily) using the submitted values, resolving a blank key against the stored key exactly as PUT does. Returns a classified per-slot result plus the exact outbound request with credentials masked to their last four characters. Saves nothing.
Exchange a valid refresh token (in the request body) for a fresh access + refresh pair. Returns 401 on invalid / expired / reused tokens; reuse triggers family-wide revocation.

Create a new user account. Returns 409 when the username is already taken. The response body carries the access token, refresh token, token type, expiry, and user profile — clients store the tokens themselves.
